researchReport.nullReasons: Every null is deliberate: the allowed official source did not publish the field, it was campus-combined rather than campus-specific, or the cycle/currentness was unclear. Each school profileStatus and fieldSources record the source-scoped reason.
researchReport.sourcePolicy: Official school, AACOM, AAMC, or TMDSAS sources only. excluded metrics excluded.
researchReport.nullReasonPolicy: Every null queryable field carries a structured reason: not-published, not-found, or not-applicable. not-found fields are the only targets for later gap-fill sweeps.
